cli.usage:
agentctl — talks to agentd over local Unix socket

  agentctl status
  agentctl providers
  agentctl tasks ls|get|create|pause|resume|run|versions|rollback|tag
  agentctl runs [--task ID] | runs stop --id RUN
  agentctl amend propose|list|confirm|reject|resolve
  agentctl amend confirm --batch <amendment_id> [--only req1,req2]   (one version for the whole batch)
  agentctl skills import|list|rollback|pin
  agentctl spend summary|set-budget
  agentctl webui [on|off|status]
  agentctl auth set-password|totp-setup|totp-disable
  agentctl version

IPC path: $TIDEBOT_HOME/agentd.sock (or config ipc_path / TIDEBOT_IPC)
Language: TIDEBOT_LANG=en|zh-CN (default: system locale)
  agentctl update check|apply
cli.use_tasks: use: agentctl tasks create ... && agentctl tasks run --id <id>
desktop.n.approval_body: %d new requirement item(s) waiting for confirmation
desktop.n.disk_low_body: tidebot keeps its database, run logs and artifacts on this disk. When it fills up, runs fail. Free some space or clean up old logs in Settings › Data.
desktop.n.interrupted_body: tidebot quit before this run finished (crash, force quit or power loss). It is marked canceled; rerun it from Runs.
desktop.n.still_running: Tidebot keeps running in the tray
desktop.p.daemon_down: The core is not responding — click to open
desktop.p.failed: %d run(s) failed in the last hour
notify.test_body: If you can read this, this channel works. Notices you picked in Settings → Notifications will arrive here.
update.n.rolled_back: Update to %s failed and was rolled back
cli.update_notify_only: This install (%v) is updated by its package manager / image; not applying.
cli.update_self_built: This copy was built from source, so it is never replaced with official binaries automatically. Download the official build by hand: %v
cli.update_self_built_dev: Development build (compiled from source): no automatic updates. The latest official release is %v.
